suite: UI_19 adventures and SRD creature traits
source: Recorded unittest outputs from the completed implementation session; tests were not rerun to prepare this report.

latest_results.aggregation: Latest actual result of each test, collected across the initial run and focused reruns. This is not a claim of a later single seven-test run.

failure.cause: A room decoration narrowed the doorway to the final chamber.
failure.fix: Room decorations were moved away from doorway approaches. Lower-terrace discoveries and spawns were also moved onto the exposed ledge after the separate continent integration check.

runs.reason: Verify actual collision reachability after the doorway and terrace corrections.
The existing Undead Fortitude test was extended to exercise a real critical hit through Game.hit_enemy after the central critical flag integration.

Final focused rerun after adding the six extra initially present quest guards and explicit loot entries. Checks now require enough initially present targets for each kill objective and valid loot templates without rings.

tests.name: test_adventure_ui19.AdventureCombat.test_grick_grapple_is_persistent_escapable_and_ends_out_of_reach
tests.checks: Grick grapple DC 12, availability of the existing escape_grapple action, persistence through condition ticking, stopped movement, successful escape and release outside reach.

tests.name: test_adventure_ui19.AdventureCombat.test_multiattack_rolls_separately_and_damage_types_match
tests.checks: Animated Armor makes two separate attack rolls; Giant Bat bite uses piercing damage.

tests.name: test_adventure_ui19.AdventureCombat.test_poison_condition_immunity_and_flight_speed
tests.checks: Poison damage and poisoned/stinking_poison immunity for the relevant creatures; actual Giant Bat flying movement speed.

tests.name: test_adventure_ui19.AdventureCombat.test_undead_fortitude_con_save_and_exceptions
tests.checks: Successful and failed Constitution saves, critical-hit exclusion, radiant damage and mixed radiant component exclusion, plus critical propagation through the real Game.hit_enemy caller.

tests.name: test_adventure_ui19.AdventureWorld.test_content_references_and_unique_rewards
tests.checks: 18 quests, 12 NPCs, unique greetings and IDs, valid dependencies and discovery references, eight distinct final item rewards, enough initially present monsters for each kill objective.

tests.name: test_adventure_ui19.AdventureWorld.test_every_chamber_and_objective_is_reachable_inside_its_floor
tests.checks: Flood-fill using Game.blocked across all 19 new dungeon/terrace areas. Discoveries, stairs and spawns are unblocked and reachable from an entrance on their floor.

tests.name: test_adventure_ui19.AdventureWorld.test_monster_stat_blocks_and_svg_assets
tests.checks: Six configured creature HP/AC/attack/XP and attack profiles match authored SRD fixtures; declared saving throw bonuses match; six four-frame SVGs parse with 320x80 dimensions; loot entries reference valid templates and contain no rings.

limitations: The topology test checks interior collision reachability; surface approaches and the port network are recorded separately in continent_results.json.
SVG verification here checks asset structure and metadata, not a separate rendered visual review.
